newsitem.title: INDIA: I-Sec's Indian bond recommendations for this month.
newsitem.headline: I-Sec's Indian bond recommendations for this month.

text.p: ICCI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it recommended three Indian government securities as the best buys this month.
"As of now, the 13.50 percent 1998 (conversion) (and) 13.62 percent 1998 seem to be the most attractive securities, trading near 13.40 percent levels," it said in a debt market update.
"A drop in yields by even 20 basis points would translate into a 30 paise to 35 paise gain in these bonds," it said.

Another attractive security is the 13.50 percent 1997 which offers a money market yield of 13.27 percent compared to the 364-day treasury bill of similar maturity trading at 12.85 percent," I-Sec said.
A realignment of the money market yield on the 13.50 percent 1997 would result in a gain of about 30 paise for this security, it said.
It said the price rise seen last week was largely restricted to the very short maturity bonds and with expectations of interest rates easing, the gain is likely to shift ahead of the yield curve.
